title: Accounts Payable Assistant - Hybrid
description:
Sheridan Maine is working with a well-established and growing business in Bournemouth to recruit an experienced Accounts Payable Assistant to join its friendly and supportive finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a successful, values-driven organisation with a portfolio of well-known consumer brands and an excellent reputation for its positive working culture.
The role offers a varied workload, hybrid working and an attractive benefits package, making it an excellent opportunity for someone with previous purchase ledger experience who enjoys being part of a collaborative finance team.

The Role
Reporting into the finance team, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the purchase ledger, ensuring invoices, payments and expenses are processed accurately and efficiently.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes, ensuring accurate coding and posting to the accounting system.
- Maintaining supplier accounts and ensuring records are accurate and up to date.
- Preparing and processing supplier payment runs in line with agreed payment terms.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.
- Handling supplier queries relating to invoices, payments and account balances.
- Processing employee expenses and company credit card transactions.
- Assisting with month-end activities, including reconciliations, journals and accruals.
- Supporting audit requirements and identifying opportunities to improve existing processes.

About You
The successful candidate will have previous experience working in an Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger role and will be confident managing a busy workload while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger position.
- Good knowledge of invoice processing, supplier reconciliations and payment runs.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with suppliers and colleagues.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and meeting deadlines.

In addition to hybrid working, the business offers an excellent range of benefits.

If you're an experienced Purchase Ledger Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Bournemouth, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Sheridan Maine for further information.

Apply today or contact Mandy Marsh for a confidential discussion.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the UK full-time without restriction.
Due to the volume of applications received, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. If you haven't heard from us within five working days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Receptionist
description: We are seeking a friendly, enthusiastic, and flexible team member to join our caring and supportive Reception Team and to cover administrative duties . You will provide an integral link between our patients and our clinicians. This role will also include other administrative duties such as monitoring SystmConnect queries and responding to patient queries. The Practice is open from 08:00 to 18:30 Monday to Friday This is a 12 month fixed term contract for 25-30 Hours to cover maternity leave Main duties You will be a critical part of the front of house team, responsible for assisting patients and health care professionals. This position encompasses traditional reception duties. You will be a central contact point for all patient enquires, both face to face and by telephone, to ensure they are directed to the most appropriate person or place for their care. There are many other administrative aspects of the role that goes on behind the scenes that is also a big part of running the GP Practice which will offer a wide variety of tasks each day. Job description Undertake all roles within reception including answering the telephone, making, and cancelling appointments, assisting patients face to face with any queries on the front desk, completing tasks. To act as a care navigator, ensuring the patient is signposted to the most appropriate service or clinician. Process SystmConnects in accordance to Practice procedure Ensure the reception and waiting area are kept neat and tidy. To be familiar with the appointment system, ensuring sufficient information is recorded on the medical records when booking appointments. Receive and make calls as required. Divert calls and take messages as and when appropriate. Inputting data into the patients healthcare records as necessary Ensure up to date patient information is recorded To assist with administration duties such as Registrations and Scanning will also be a part of this role. Reception: Monitor effectiveness of the appointment system and report problems or variations as and when necessary. Ensure the consulting rooms are checked at the end of each day and left tidy and secure. Make up patient files and ensure records are kept tidy and in good repair with all necessary information recorded correctly on the outer cover. Taking part in regular team meetings and training.

title: Administrator
description: Regents Park Healthcare are looking for an Administrator to work within the administration team at the Dorset Heart Clinic. The right candidate should have 2 years administration experience ideally within NHS or other healthcare settings, strong IT skills and have an outgoing and friendly attitude. The work can be highly demanding, therefore, the ability to prioritise your own workload and meet deadlines is also essential. JOB TITLE: Administrator REPORTS TO: Clinic Manager LOCATION: Dorset Heart Clinic, Bournemouth, UK HOURS: Working patterns are assigned across Monday to Sat, typically covering 8am - 8pm with full-time hours equating to 37.5 per week. We expect there will be no requirement to work Bank Holidays without prior & mutual agreement. SALARY: From £25,685.00/year, depending on experience. JOB TYPE: Full-time, Permanent BENEFITS: Company events Company pension contributions Health & wellbeing programme On-site parking Private medical insurance Generous Sick pay Life Cover 25 days holiday + bank holidays RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES To liaise effectively and efficiently with (but not limited to) the following individuals/organisations: Consultants and their secretaries. Patients and their relatives. Referring GPs and their offices. Private medical insurance companies. Clinical staff. NHS Trust staff. Self-Payers; and Other third-party organisations. To manage correspondence and telephone enquiries speedily and accurately. To book outpatients appointments onto IT systems. To prepare medical notes and other clinical information in preparation for a clinical session, ensuring all paperwork is filed correctly and no notes are missing. To ensure all payments for self-payers are collected on the same day as their clinic visit wherever possible. To type letters and other correspondence accurately and swiftly. To ensure a log of any payments received is completed on a weekly basis and updated on the appropriate management systems. To provide clinic receptionist duties if required to do so. To maintain inventory of supplies. To collaborate closely with medical staff, department heads, and other administrators to support effective communication, collaboration, and problem-solving. To undertake mandatory training relevant to the role to remain compliant with our ways of working. Any other duties that may be required consistent with the nature and grade of the post.

title: Ward Clerk - Stroke Unit
company: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for a Ward Clerk to join our team here on the Stroke Unit, to work with our staff to support the day to day running of an dynamic ward, liaise with various teams throughout the Trust, facilitate safe discharges from hospital and help communicate with patients, their friends, and family. The successful applicant will enjoy working in a busy fast paced environment, will work closely with members of the multidisciplinary team to maintain smooth running of the ward service and care. They must have excellent communication skills, have a putting patients first approach to work, be able to prioritise, organise, be highly motivated; possess a calm approach to the working day and have a good sense of humour. They will also need to be able to keep clear records in line with information governance. You will be required to work Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays, covering the seven days a week service with our current Ward Clerks.
